info.title: uSync.Cli
info.description: uSync command line tool for Umbraco

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: test
commands.description: Test command

commands.name: config-check
commands.description: Show the server, client id and secret in use and where each came from, then check they sign in

options.name: --server-url
options.description: The URL of the uSync server (or set USYNC_SERVER)

options.name: --secret
options.description: The secret key for the uSync server (or set USYNC_CLIENT_SECRET)

options.name: --client-id
options.description: The client ID for the uSync server (or set USYNC_CLIENT_ID)

commands.name: files-verify
commands.description: Check the uSync folder for problems (merge conflicts, clashes, broken files). Offline, no server needed.

options.name: --folder
options.description: uSync folder (default: from appsettings.json uSync:Settings:RootFolder, else the highest uSync/v{n} folder)

options.name: --content
options.description: also check the Content, Media and Blueprints folders

options.name: --format
options.description: output format (default: github when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, else text)

options.name: --output
options.description: write the output (sarif / junit) to this file instead of the console

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: fail (exit 1) on warnings too

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: only report problems in files changed since this git ref (e.g. origin/main)

options.name: --summary
options.description: write a markdown summary to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY (or the console), listing the items changed since --changed-since

options.name: --publish-folder
options.description: check this publish output contains the uSync folder and its files

commands.name: files-webhook
commands.description: Add a 'uSync Site Started' webhook to the uSync folder, so the site tells your pipeline when a deploy is up. Needs the uSync.Command.Notify package on the site.

options.name: --repo
options.description: GitHub repo (owner/name) whose workflow should run when the site starts

options.name: --url
options.description: send to this https url instead of GitHub

options.name: --token-name
options.description: name of the secret on the site (uSync:Notify:Secrets:{name}); empty for none

options.name: --name
options.description: name of the webhook in the backoffice

options.name: --folder
options.description: uSync folder (default: from appsettings.json uSync:Settings:RootFolder, else the highest uSync/v{n} folder)

commands.name: files-diff
commands.description: List the uSync items added, changed or deleted since a git ref. Offline, needs git.

options.name: --format
options.description: output format

options.name: --folder
options.description: uSync folder (default: from appsettings.json uSync:Settings:RootFolder, else the highest uSync/v{n} folder)

arguments.name: REF
arguments.description: git ref to compare with (e.g. origin/main): changes on this branch since then, plus uncommitted ones

commands.name: files-find
commands.description: Find the uSync files for an item by key, alias or file name. Offline, no server needed.

options.name: --folder
options.description: uSync folder (default: from appsettings.json uSync:Settings:RootFolder, else the highest uSync/v{n} folder)

arguments.name: KEY_OR_ALIAS
arguments.description: the item's key (a guid), alias, or file name

commands.name: files-clean
commands.description: List uSync's delete markers with their age, and remove old ones with --remove. Offline.

options.name: --older-than
options.description: only markers last committed more than this many days ago

options.name: --remove
options.description: delete the marker files (needs --older-than). Commit the result like any other change.

options.name: --folder
options.description: uSync folder (default: from appsettings.json uSync:Settings:RootFolder, else the highest uSync/v{n} folder)

commands.name: user-current
commands.description: Fetch the user executing the commands
